label: C2 contingency grounding: power-grounded non-existence, receptivity and the First Way endpoint
summary:
Follow-up to PR #1870 (gap 1, next test 3), God-existence stage of the root; note docs/notes/contingency-receptivity-c2.md; repaired after the independent semantic challenge of head 470f90b80. Target C2: every being contingent at w is existentially receptive (esse received in a principle in RECEPTIVE_POTENCY_1 to it, or matter and form) or has a distinct SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 CAUSE_2 of its esse. Checked: C2 from PGP (contingent beings can fail to be in substance, the in-subject channel, or are under some being's broad power over their esse, POWER_OVER_ESSE_1), correlation (a co-occurrence disjunction: if y has such power, x can fail to be in substance or y is a CAUSE_2 of x's esse), passive-to-receptive, b62a64ab and B3, constructively; unreceivedness of the First Way's mover from simplicity, R3, De ente and receptive irreflexivity, constructively; the First Way's mover necessary (endpoint f9208664) from firstness, unreceivedness and C2 with excluded middle, POTENCY_1 pure act carried and unused; C2 from R1 with De ente and from B2 with B3; C2, its weak form and the certified difference (strength comparison 07689384, separator unprioritized); B2 or B4 (3c9d683b) from PGP, correlation, b62a64ab and corruptible-has-POTENCY_1. New disambiguations: f5dda05f (POWER_OVER_ESSE: broad versus giving power) and d25cee67 (POSSIBLE_NOT_TO_BE: in the subject versus through another's power; under it Aquinas denies #1870's B4a for angels). Findings: correlation yields #1870 bridge (ii) only for incorruptibles; the unrestricted form is not derived and its countermodel is an uncaused corruptible composite; B4b with adopted POTENCY_1 excludes actual corruptibles (law 10); correlation is trivial under the giving sense (law 11); C2 and B2 or B4 are independent; PGP and C2 are independent of the pure-act target; the angelic model's B4 and target failures are structural only. Provisional judgment: C2 is not contested by the recorded rivals on any corruptible or dependent being, given passive-to-receptive and B3 (both OPEN); its contested scope is exactly the foundational simple being where the route applies it, so the route's force there equals that of power-grounded modality for existence, a serious theory not shown superior here to combinatorial, primitivist, existence-conditional essentialist or hybrid rivals. Ordinary cases and the explicit case analysis do not discriminate; no substantive objection shows C2 false.

Curation pass 2, lane D (#2103, 2026-11-27). dd9bccd1 tests 6508c239. At reading world true the contingent bearer true has a distinct CAUSE_2 of its esse. The model has no reception, matter-form composition or simple-priority edges. The weaker receptive-or-cause disjunction holds and the stronger disjunction with priority fails.

Curation pass 2, lane D (#2103, 2026-11-27). cafd9800 tests 20d5fecd. Omit power grounding for actual bearers contingent at the reading world. At true in bruteFirst, f is contingent and incorruptible simply, and no bearer has POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 over f. The other four C2 route premises hold. cafd9800 tests 9163c423. Omit correlation on the broad POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 reading. In the bruteFirst variant of SelfAnnihilatorModel, the contingent f at true has power over its own esse while f is incorruptible simply and no one causes its esse. The other four C2 route premises hold. cafd9800 tests b62a64ab. Omit the prohibition of self-esse-causation. In selfCauser, f both has POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 over its own esse and causes it. At true f is contingent, and the frame has no distinct esse-cause. The other four C2 route premises hold. cafd9800 tests 16c760a3. Omit the passage from simple corruptibility to existential receptivity. In uncausedX the contingent bearer x at true can fail to be at esse, with no received esse or matter-form composition. No one has power over its esse, and no one causes its esse. cafd9800 tests ee74c678. Omit simple priority for a distinct CAUSE_2 at esse. In unprioritized, x causes the esse of the contingent bearer f at true. The distinct pair has no simple-priority edge. C2-minus holds there and the other four C2 power-grounding premises hold. cafd9800 tests 8a8d00e9. Test stronger B2 with B3 held fixed. The contingent x at true in uncausedX receives esse in a principle in receptive potency to it, so C2 holds. The esse-cause relation is empty, so x fails B2 and B3 holds vacuously. cafd9800 tests ae9d9473. Test stronger R1 with the receiver reading held fixed. In CorruptorModel the contingent x at true is composed of matter and form, satisfying C2 by receptivity. Reception is empty, so x fails R1 and the receiver reading holds vacuously. cafd9800 tests 6508c239. Omit C2 in the route to the necessary First Way mover. In bruteFirst, f is the pure-act first mover among the two modeled respects, exists at true, and is absent at false. It is unreceived and lacks a distinct prior esse-cause. The other nonlogical inputs hold. The route takes excluded middle explicitly. cafd9800 tests 82ad1978. Witness all five power-grounding premises together at true. The two actual bearers are the necessary f and the contingent x. The frame gives x simple corruptibility and gives f both POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 over x and a distinct simply prior CAUSE_2 at esse. Reception and matter-form composition realize the passive-to-receptive premise. cafd9800 tests 00b384a1. Witness power grounding, broad correlation, no self-esse-cause and corruptible-to-potency together. At true f and x both exist, and x alone is contingent. x is corruptible at esse and in POTENCY_1 in heat. The frame assigns f power over x's esse and the only esse-causal edge f to x. cafd9800 tests f68a5d87. Witness simplicity, identity-scoped reception, receiver potency and receptive irreflexivity in the two-bearer witness frame. The first mover f moves x in heat, and x receives esse in a principle distinct from and in receptive potency to x's esse. The first mover f has neither reception nor matter-form composition. cafd9800 retains a nonlogical witness for f644aee8. The whole-argument link to f644aee8 from #2126 was removed. WitnessModel does not certify ExcludedMiddle over arbitrary propositions. Witness the First Way premise bundle at true with two present bearers. The unreceived pure-act first mover f moves the contingent x in heat. The only contingent bearer x satisfies C2 by reception and by a distinct prior esse-cause. The argument takes excluded middle explicitly. cafd9800 tests 38394aad. Witness R1 and the receiver reading together in uncausedX at true. Both bearers exist and x is contingent. Its esse is received in the principle false, which is in receptive potency to the esse-principle true. cafd9800 tests 61924ce7. Witness B2 and B3 together in the two-bearer witness frame at true. The only contingent bearer x has f as a distinct esse-cause, and the sole esse-causal edge is simply prior. cafd9800 tests 0a06cc95. Witness C2-minus and B3 together in the two-bearer witness frame at true. The contingent x is receptive and has a distinct esse-cause f. The same edge is simply prior, and there are no other distinct esse-cause edges. The unrestricted power-to-cause premise in CorruptorModel is off path at its full scope. Its restriction to incorruptibles holds. The B2-or-B4 and pure-act comparisons are independence results, with the angelic reading confined to the two modeled respects. 7fcf8487 records the equivalence of C2 with its weak form plus the difference, and dd9bccd1 is the separate strictness witness.
blocker: No premise is established; B2 or B4 3c9d683b is now derived (proved, not established), its leaf replaced by four new bare premises: PGP 20d5fecd, correlation 9163c423, passive-to-receptive 16c760a3, corruptible-has-POTENCY_1 8bfc4ab7. Standing rival: a contingent, simple, unreceived, uncaused first actuality on a hybrid view (act and potency for change, non-power modality for existence), priced at de re possibility of absence with no internal or external modal ground. The B2, B6 and PGP routes face correlated denials from one Humean or primitivist package. Next tests: (1) matching-scope comparison of modal theories for existence; (2) tensed conserving strengthening of correlation via c94eed5b (the deist question); (3) passive-to-receptive for a corruptible without matter; (4) corruptible-has-POTENCY_1; (5) C1 connection bridges (no actual esse-cause to firstness; CCR root to unreceivedness) and q.3 a.7.
